en.p: As shown in the figure, there are 2 black cards and 8 white cards on which the natural numbers from 1 to 8 are written, one on each. When all of these cards are used exactly once and arranged in a row from left to right, find the number of arrangements satisfying the following conditions. (Here the black cards are not distinguished from each other.) [4 points]

box: (A) The cards are placed so that the numbers on the white cards are arranged in increasing order from left to right.
(B) At least 2 white cards are placed between the black cards.
(C) At least 1 white card with a multiple of 3 written on it is placed between the black cards.
